Use the data API to create two synthetic public report folders and sort their IDs. Create three public report folders with unique Name and DeveloperName values, with ParentId null, lower and higher respectively. Re-query the three references and identify records as N, L, H. At each API version query the three records with ORDER BY ParentId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST. Apex DML does not support creating this object.
